description: Clipboard text-to-speech desktop app with local and cloud voice engines, captions, tray integration, and browser companion.
notes: Scoop extracts the official MSI into the application directory; the MSI is not installed system-wide.

Roaming, LocalAppData, and Documents data directories are linked to Scoop's persistent data folder. Existing CopySpeech/CopySpeak data is moved only when the destination has no filename conflicts; conflicts stop installation without overwriting data.
The first launch may download selected local TTS engines and voice models. CopySpeech also offers cloud engines.
CopySpeech includes an in-app updater; use Scoop as the update authority to avoid competing updates.
